label: TP
reason: User input flows through getParameter -> doSomething -> bar -> printf format string sink. The doSomething() sanitization (substring removing last char) is ineffective against XSS via format strings since attackers can craft multi-char payloads that bypass the check. The printf call passes bar as the format string argument, allowing %n, %s, etc. injection.

evidence.note: user param flows to printf format string sink without effective neutralization
